reading: Re-run on a clean stage (no other session recorded), with a client kept connected so the Environment does not reset. The unwatched tab and its Browser Run session lived the whole 14 minutes: Browser Run's 10-minute keep-alive never fired, because the Shadow's 60-second profile save (storageState over CDP) is traffic. So the plan's expectation (keep-alive ends an unwatched tab) does not hold: an open tab holds its browser for as long as anything keeps the Environment awake, as stock keeps a tab while its server runs. With no client the Environment resets about 60 s after the last request, and the reset closes its sessions (Browser Run history: NormalClosure, lives of 92, 327 and 359 s in the earlier runs). Filed as a cost follow-up rather than a stock departure.
